ph.title: Main photo
ph.sub: The photo on top of “{title}”. Only the shop's own pictures: the article's product photos first, then the photo library.
ph.off: The shop shows no main photo yet: the “Main photos on the shop” card is off. You can still pick one now.
ph.none: No main photo yet: pick one below.

src.productsSub: Photos of the products in the article's product block, in the block's order, the main one first.
src.productsEmpty: These products have no photos yet.
src.librarySub: The shop's other pictures, newest first.
src.libraryEmpty: No other pictures yet: photos come in on a product's page.

ph.noProducts: The article has no products yet.
ph.cardText: Off: the shop's article pages show no main photo. On: each article shows the photo picked here, with its alt text.
ph.studioHint: AI-made pictures from the library; under the photo it always says “Studio image”.
ph.readOnly: You can see the pictures; picking needs the write permission, the card the publish permission.
ph.rule1: Our own product photos first, then the photo library.
ph.rule2: No picture from a web address: nothing is taken from an image search.
ph.rule3: A studio picture is always labelled and is never proof of fit or care.
ph.rule4: Free-licence libraries come with their own keys; AI pictures ask you every time, in the AI Center.

jr.title: Blog & journal
jr.sub: Articles that bring people from search to the shop: write, check in three steps, then schedule or publish.
jr.off: The journal is switched off: the shop's /journal page still says “Coming soon”. You can write, check and publish; customers see the articles once you switch it on in the card below.
jr.emptySub: “New article” starts one. Ideas, drafts and put-away articles stay here; nothing is deleted.

card.d: Whether customers see the journal, and its numbers. Off as it ships.
card.readOnly: Only someone who may publish articles can change this.
card.on: Show the journal on the shop
card.relatedProducts: Products in an article's product block (0 = none)
card.relatedArticles: "Read next" links under an article (0 = none)
card.reviewByAnother: Nobody passes the review of his own article
card.aiNote: Honest line beside an AI author (empty = the shop's own words)
card.tags: Show tags, each with its own page
card.authorPages: A page for each author and reviewer
card.rss: RSS feed of the newest articles

e.linkHelp: The address: {path}. Latin letters, digits and hyphens; a Bengali title needs one typed.
e.author: Author
e.reviewerHelp: The expert who checked the article (someone other than its author). Their name shows under the title and, while author pages are on, links to their page.
e.tagsHelp: Words that group articles, split by commas (for example: polo, washing). While tags are on, each tag has its own page.
e.bodyHelp: A blank line between paragraphs. ## heading · ### sub-heading · - bullet · 1. numbered · > tip: … · > note: … · [products] where the product block goes · **bold** · [words](/collections/polos) for a link.
e.productsHere: The product block shows here ({n} products).
e.gaps: Still missing before it can go live: {fields}
e.liveNow: This article is on the shop now.
e.readOnly: You can see this article; changing it needs the writer's or publisher's permission.

sh.title: Categories & authors
sh.sub: The journal's sections and the names its articles are signed with. Put away, never deleted.
sh.catsSub: Main categories and their sub-categories (two levels).
sh.authorsSub: An AI author is always shown as one on the shop.
sh.parentNone: None — this is a main category
sh.reviewer: Checked-by line (only a real person's name)

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile; the page shows the latest now. Make your change again.
err.SLUG_TAKEN: That link is taken in this language; pick another.
err.WRONG_STATE: That step is not open in this state.
err.NOT_READY: Not ready to go live: {fields} missing.
err.OWN_ARTICLE: You wrote this article; another person passes its checks.
err.ARCHIVED: A put-away article cannot be changed; restore it first.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.LINKS_MISSING: Required links missing (Topic plan): {paths}. Add them to the words first.
err.ALIKE: A very close article or topic exists: {fields}. Press again to add it anyway.
err.BRIEF_TAKEN: That topic has its brief already; open it from the Topic plan.
err.BRIEF_MISSING: This topic needs its brief before writing starts: press “Brief”.
err.AI_OFF: AI drafting is off: turn on AI for the shop and “AI first drafts” first.
err.DAILY_LIMIT: Today’s AI drafts are used up ({fields} a day). Try again tomorrow, or write it by hand.
err.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI writer did not answer; try again in a while.
err.DAY_FULL: That day already has the most articles a day (Calendar card). Pick another day.

pl.title: Topic plan
pl.sub: Which articles to write, and how they link: one pillar guide per subject, its supporting articles around it, all pointing at one shop page.
pl.clustersSub: A cluster is one subject: the pillar article, its supporting articles and the topics still to write.
pl.noClusters: No cluster yet. Add the first one on the right.
pl.addPost: Add an article to this cluster
pl.name: Name (English)
pl.newClusterSub: One subject people search for, such as polo care or winter layering.
pl.looseSub: Nothing in the plan points at these yet; add each to the cluster it belongs to.
pl.looseNone: Every article is in a cluster.
pl.newTopicSub: Your own topic is approved at once; a writer's waits for the owner's yes.
pl.isPillar: This is the cluster's pillar article
pl.author: Writer
pl.authorAuto: The section's own author under Doot writes it
pl.alikeNone: Not alike any article or topic.
pl.alikeAgain: A very close article or topic exists: {fields}. Press again to add it anyway.
pl.started: The draft is made; opening the editor.
pl.how1: Make a cluster for each subject and choose the shop page its articles lead to.
pl.how2: Add topics: what to write and what people search. Very close topics are caught before they are added.
pl.how3: Start writing makes the draft inside the cluster; mark one article as its pillar.
pl.how4: The list shows which links each article still needs. With the rule on, an article goes live only with them.

card.d: Which links the articles of a cluster must carry, and how alike two topics may be. Refusing to publish is off as it ships.
card.requireLinks: Refuse publishing while a required link is missing
card.linkPillar: Supporting articles link to their pillar
card.linkTarget: Articles link to the cluster's shop page
card.pillarLinksAll: The pillar links to every live article of its cluster
card.dupWarn: Very close from (%) — needs a second press

pl.queueOwner: Topics from the writers wait here, month by month. Say yes or no one by one, or approve a whole month at once; a very close one is held for you.
pl.queueAuto: Topics are approved by themselves now; only the ones held for you (very close to an article or topic) wait here.
pl.digestEmpty: Nothing was decided by itself in these days.

acard.d: Who decides which articles get written, and whether finished articles go live by themselves. The owner decides, as it ships.
acard.holdAlike: Hold very close topics for the owner
acard.autoPublish: Publish by itself once the last check passes (only with “By itself”)

br.title: Brief
br.sub: Chosen before a single word is written: the topic, its language, how many words and the keywords. The rest helps the writer.
br.topicPick: Choose a topic from the plan
br.topicNewHelp: A new topic joins the Topic plan; a writer’s waits for the owner’s yes.
br.keywordsHelp: Separated by commas; the first one leads.
br.i_info: To know (a guide or an answer)
br.mustIncludeHelp: Sizes, care steps, prices from the live rules — only what is true.
br.linksHelp: One shop path a line, e.g. /collections/polos.
br.shotListHelp: One photo a line; our own photos first.
br.img_library: Own photos first, then the picture library
br.img_aiAsk: An AI picture only with a yes each time
br.none: No open topic. Add one on the Topic plan, or type a new one here.

card.d: How a new brief starts, and whether writing waits for one. As it ships writing does not wait.
card.wordsMin: Fewest words a brief may ask
card.wordsMax: Most words a brief may ask

ai.d: Writes a first draft of the article from this brief, in its language. A person still edits it and it passes the three review steps.
ai.go: Write the first draft with AI
ai.done: The draft is ready; the editor opens.
ai.donePractice: Practice draft ready (no AI key yet); the editor opens.
ai.used: {n} of {max} drafts in the last 24 hours.
ai.b_aiOff: AI is off for the whole shop (AI section).
ai.b_off: AI drafts are off — turn them on in the card below.
ai.b_notApproved: The topic waits for the owner’s yes first.
ai.b_started: The article is already started; open it.
ai.b_limit: Today’s AI drafts are used up.
ai.practiceBox: Practice text from the practice writer — no AI key is entered yet. Rewrite it before the review.

card.d: Off as it ships. It also needs AI on for the whole shop.
card.enabled: Offer “Write the first draft with AI”
card.dailyMax: Most AI drafts in a day

src.meta: Write from a link · Blog & journal
src.title: Write from a link
src.sub: Paste a link to an article anywhere in the world. The writer reads it, researches the topic and writes an original piece — never a copy — in the language you pick.
src.urlHelp: https://… — any page with an article on it.
src.done: The draft is ready; the editor opens.
src.donePractice: Practice draft ready (no AI key yet); the editor opens.
src.used: {n} of {max} drafts in the last 24 hours.
src.b_aiOff: AI is off for the whole shop (AI section).
src.b_off: Write from a link is off — turn it on in the card below.
src.practiceBox: Practice text from the practice writer — no AI key is entered yet. Rewrite it before the review.
src.err_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: Not a web address, or this site is not allowed (settings below).
src.err_PAGE_UNREADABLE: Could not read an article on that page.
src.err_AI_UNAVAILABLE: The writer is not available right now; try again.
src.err_AI_OFF: AI is off for the shop, or “Write from a link” is off.

card.d: Off as it ships. It also needs AI on for the whole shop.
card.hosts: Sites allowed (one a line; empty = any site)

cal.title: Publish calendar
cal.sub: When each finished article goes live: the publishing times of the days ahead, the month, and the articles waiting for a time.
cal.fewSlots: Only {n} publishing times a day, but the target is {target} — add more times in the card below.
cal.aheadSub: Each publishing time with its article, or free. Times are in the shop's time zone ({tz}).
cal.legend: Green number: live. Blue: some are scheduled. Tap a day to see its articles.
cal.readySub: Articles that passed all three review steps. Highest priority topic first.
cal.placeOne: Give it the next free time
cal.noFree: No free time left in the days ahead.
cal.how1: An article that passes its last review step (SEO) waits here as finished.
cal.how2: “Fill the free times” gives each finished article with nothing missing the next free time; an unfinished one is never used to fill a time.
cal.how3: A scheduled article goes live by itself at its time. Change or remove its time in the article's editor.
cal.how4: With “Place by itself” on, a finished article takes the next free time straight away.

card.d: The day's publishing times and how many articles a day.
card.perDayTarget: Target a day (the fill stops here)
card.perDayMax: Most a day (scheduling by hand stops here)
card.daysAhead: Days ahead to fill and show
card.autoFillHelp: Off as it ships. When on, a finished article takes the next free time as soon as its last review step passes.

perf.title: Content performance
perf.sub: Which articles bring readers, and which bring orders.
perf.off: Counting is off, so readers and orders from articles stay at 0. Turn on “Count readers and orders” in the card below; counting starts from that moment (nothing before it can be recovered).
perf.kOrdersS: of {n} orders placed in the shop
perf.noShare: no orders in the shop yet
perf.listSub: Live articles, and any article that had readers or orders in the period. Sales first, then Ordered value, then readers.
perf.none: No live articles yet, and no article had readers or orders in this period.
perf.rules: Sales counts only delivered orders, on the day each was delivered; Ordered value counts every placed order on the day it was placed. An order counts for an article when the same browser read it in the {w} days before ordering.
perf.creditLast: Only the last article read gets the order, so the rows add up to the total.
perf.creditEvery: Every article read gets the order, so one order can be in several rows; the total above counts it once.
perf.noMoney: Amounts need the “See reports” permission; you see order counts.
perf.how1: Turn on counting in the card. From then on each article page counts its readers: the same browser once a day.
perf.how2: Where a reader came from: a search engine, video site or AI assistant from the SEO organic list; another page of the shop; or anything else.
perf.how3: When someone orders, the articles that browser read in the last days you set get the order. Only article ids and times are kept in the browser — nothing about the person.
perf.how4: Use it to see which topics bring buyers: write more like the top rows, and give the “readers, no orders yet” articles better product links.

card.d: Off as it ships. Only article ids and times are kept in the reader’s browser.
card.countHelp: The article pages count readers, and orders credit the articles read before them.
card.windowDays: Days before an order that a read still counts
card.days: Days the report shows when it opens

cm.title: Comments
cm.sub: What readers wrote under the articles. Nothing is shown before a person presses Show.
cm.off: Comments are off: the journal runs without comments, and the articles show no comment part. Turn them on in the card below if you want readers' comments.
cm.queueSub: {n} waiting — each shows under its article only after Show
cm.search: Search the words, names or articles
cm.listEmptyText: When comments are on, readers' comments come here.
cm.cardText: Off = the journal runs without comments. On: readers may comment; each one waits for Show.
cm.perDay: Comments one person may leave in a day
cm.readOnly: Only a person with the publish permission can show or hide comments and change this card.
cm.how1: Off as shipped: the journal runs without comments and the article page has no comment part.
cm.how2: On: a reader writes under a live article (signed in only, unless you allow anyone with a name), within the length and the day's number in the card.
cm.how3: Each comment waits here. Only Show puts it under its article; Hide takes it away again. Undo puts back what you just did.
cm.how4: Nothing is deleted: a hidden comment stays here under Hidden. Only the first word of a name is shown.

sc.title: Shared calendar
sc.sub: One calendar for the journal, the social studio and Marketing: what is coming, day by day, before you choose a day for an article.
sc.emptyText: Articles with a day, campaigns, plans and cut-offs come here.
sc.noteSocial: The social studio reads this same calendar: its posts are here beside the articles. Read-only — open an item to change it.
sc.noteClosed: Social posts come here too once the social studio is opened. Read-only — open an item to change it.

sd.title: What articles sold
sd.sub: The products bought after reading each article: from its own product block, or besides.
sd.off: Counting is off, so nothing is counted here yet. Turn on "Count readers and orders" on the Performance page.
sd.emptyText: Orders placed after reading an article come here, with their products.
sd.noteLast: Each order goes to the last article read before it, so the articles' rows can be added up.
sd.noteEvery: Each order goes to every article read before it: an order can be under several articles, so do not add the rows up.
sd.noMoney: Amounts are shown only with the reports permission; here, pieces only.
